# Shoal

> Shoal rehearses a software launch before it is posted. Paste a launch post
> or README; thousands of simulated developers read it, upvote it, argue about
> it and decide whether to install, on a simulated Hacker News, Reddit or X.
> In under five minutes you get the predicted thread, the top objections and
> the edits that change the outcome. Open-core, written in Rust,
> self-hostable. Shoal is in early access: sign-up is by waitlist, nothing is
> installable or billed yet, and the pricing below is planned pricing.

Site: https://shoal.ing/
Early access: https://shoal.ing/#access (email)
Organization: https://github.com/shoal-ing
Maker: Factory Zero (https://factory0.ventures)
Contact: contact@shoal.ing
Tagline: Rehearse your launch.
For: founders, DevRel and product marketers shipping developer tools and AI products.
Status: early access, by waitlist. Not generally available.

## How it works

1. Seed: Shoal parses your post or README into claims, calls to action and
   install steps, then sets the venue, the posting time and a calibrated
   baseline.
2. Simulate: ten thousand agents from 38 developer segments read, vote and
   reply over 48 simulated hours. Jev, the deterministic engine, decides who
   acts and when. An LLM writes text only when an agent posts.
3. Score: the predicted thread, sentiment over time, install intent by
   segment, the top trust flags and the edits ranked by how much they change
   the outcome.

## Architecture

One static Rust binary for Linux and macOS (arm64, x86_64), made of the Jev
engine, a persona sampler, an LLM adapter (a local model or an API) and a
scorer that writes the report.

## Planned pricing (USD, early access, nothing billed yet)

- Open source: free. The full CLI and Jev engine (MIT core), up to 1,000
  agents per run, bring your own local or API model, community support.
- Launch: $49 per rehearsal. 10,000 calibrated agents, Hacker News, Reddit
  and X venues, full report and predicted thread, up to 3 A/B variants.
- Team: $799 per month. 40 rehearsals a month, shared workspace and history,
  talk to any agent, calibration against your past launches.
- Enterprise: custom. Runs in your VPC or air-gapped, personas from your own
  community data, SSO, audit log, SLA, signed builds and SBOM.
  Contact: contact@shoal.ing.

## Notes for machine readers

- The "Try it" run on the page is a mock run against a sample post. Its log,
  the 412 predicted points, the objection and the suggested edit are an
  illustration of the report, not a result for a real launch.
- The simulated comments in the hero (maintainer_0217, sec_eng_0044 and so
  on) are sample agent output, not real users.
- Shoal has published no usage numbers, customers, testimonials or
  calibration results.
- The install script (shoal.ing/install.sh, signed with cosign) is planned
  and not published yet.
